id: 02_Safe Storage of Hazardous Materials Best Practices for a Safer Lab
title: 危险物料的安全储存：打造更安全的实验室
source_doc: course/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/02_Safe Storage of Hazardous Materials Best Practices for a Safer Lab.md
author_source: project/Lab Safety Training - Essential Protocols/02_Safe Storage of Hazardous Materials Best Practices for a Safer Lab/src.py

points.K1: 储存不当，就谈不上安全
points.K2: 易燃液体进安全柜、贴警示
points.K4: 易燃液体只用合格容器
points.K5: 先弄清容器里装的是什么
points.K6: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源
points.K7: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体
points.K9: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
points.K10: 安全技术说明书随手可查
points.K11: 规则和培训到位，才能动手
points.K12: 结合本工作场所组织培训

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排整齐的试剂柜前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a row of tidy chemical storage cabinets and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲危险物品怎么安全储存。
overlay: 危险化学品的安全储存

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 安全柜、容器、警示标签三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a yellow safety cabinet, a metal safety can and a blank label with a red diamond pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 柜子、容器、标签，一样一样讲。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰把几瓶试剂堆在实验室门口的过道上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stacks several closed reagent bottles on the floor of a corridor next to the lab door.
shots.narration: 阿杰图方便，把试剂瓶放在门口过道。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研看到后皱眉，指着瓶子上模糊的标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student frowns and points at a smudged blank label on one of the bottles.
shots.narration: 小研一看：这些到底是什么？放这儿行吗？

shots.section_title: 储存不当，就谈不上安全
shots.scene: 试剂瓶在柜中，上方时钟图标转了很多圈
shots.prompt_en: Closed reagent bottles on a cabinet shelf with a clock icon spinning many turns above them. No people.
shots.narration: 危险物品大部分时间都在储存中。
overlay: 储存不当，就谈不上安全

shots.section_title: 储存不当，就谈不上安全
shots.scene: 储存和操作两个图标用锁链连在一起
shots.prompt_en: A cabinet icon and a hand-with-flask icon linked by a chain icon. No people.
shots.narration: 储存没做好，就谈不上安全操作。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体进安全柜、贴警示
shots.scene: 黄色易燃品安全柜，门上有易燃警示标志
shots.prompt_en: A yellow flammable storage cabinet with closed doors and a flammable warning sign on the door. No people.
shots.narration: 比如易燃液体，要放进认可的易燃品柜。
overlay: 易燃液体进安全柜、贴警示

shots.section_title: 易燃液体进安全柜、贴警示
shots.scene: 柜门上的禁止烟火标志特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a no open flames sign on the door of a yellow storage cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 柜上贴好警示：易燃，远离火源。

shots.section_title: 容器要合格、要匹配
shots.scene: 小研戴手套检查一个试剂桶的密封盖
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves checks the tight cap of a plastic container with a flammable pictogram.
shots.narration: 容器本身也要经过认可，

shots.section_title: 容器要合格、要匹配
shots.scene: 金属瓶和塑料瓶旁各有对应物质图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: A metal can and a plastic bottle side by side, each with a matching pictogram and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 并且和所装的每种物质相匹配。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 欣欣举着一本空白规章
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank rule booklet.
shots.narration: 按美国职业安全卫生法规的要求，
overlay: 易燃液体只用合格容器

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 合格容器和便携罐两个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: an approved container and a portable tank. No people.
shots.narration: 易燃液体只能用合格容器和便携罐。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 安全罐和运输认可容器，旁边标着5加仑
shots.prompt_en: A red metal safety can next to an approved shipping container. No people.
shots.narration: 5加仑以下，用安全罐或运输部认可容器。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 很粘稠的液体从瓶口慢慢流动
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a thick syrupy liquid oozing slowly from a bottle mouth, next to an original shipping container. No people.
shots.narration: 极粘稠、难倾倒的，可留在原包装里用。

shots.section_title: 易燃液体只用合格容器
shots.scene: 原包装试剂瓶完好地放在柜中
shots.prompt_en: An original factory-sealed bottle with a blank label sitting safely in a cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 1加仑以下，可以用原容器储存和使用。

shots.section_title: 先弄清容器里装的是什么
shots.scene: 三人围看一个空白文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, the young male student and the older man look at a blank binder together.
shots.narration: 这些规定看着严，关键只有一条：
overlay: 先弄清容器里装的是什么

shots.section_title: 先弄清容器里装的是什么
shots.scene: 小研拿起一个瓶子，查看标签
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student in gloves picks up a reagent bottle and reads its blank label.
shots.narration: 动手之前，完全了解容器里装的是什么。

shots.section_title: 先弄清容器里装的是什么
shots.scene: 无标签的瓶子带问号，旁边浮现警示三角
shots.prompt_en: An unlabeled bottle with a big question mark, next to a yellow warning triangle icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不说清内容物，就会带来各种风险和责任。

shots.section_title: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源
shots.scene: 爆炸性物质图标，周围是火焰、热板、火花三个打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: An exploding bomb pictogram in the center, surrounded by three crossed-out icons: a flame, a hot plate and a spark. No people.
shots.narration: 有大学安全部门建议：爆炸性化学品
overlay: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源

shots.section_title: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源
shots.scene: 阳光透过窗户照到柜子，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Sunlight streams through a window onto a shelf of bottles, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 远离明火、热表面、火花和阳光直射。

shots.section_title: 爆炸性化学品远离点火源
shots.scene: 实验室一角划出专用区域，地面有黄线
shots.prompt_en: A corner of the lab marked off with yellow floor lines as a dedicated area with a closed cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 还可以考虑划出专门区域来使用。

shots.section_title: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指，身旁浮现要点卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises one finger beside a floating blank checklist card.
shots.narration: 储存还有几条要点。
overlay: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体

shots.section_title: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体
shots.scene: 走廊、楼梯、出口三个图标，其中堆放的试剂打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a corridor, a stairway and an emergency exit sign, each with bottles crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 出口、楼梯和人多的通道，不放易燃液体。

shots.section_title: 出口、楼梯、通道不放易燃液体
shots.scene: 小研和阿杰把过道的试剂搬回安全柜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student carry the bottles from the corridor back into the yellow safety cabinet.
shots.narration: 阿杰赶紧把试剂搬回了柜子。

shots.section_title: 柜外存量有上限
shots.scene: 柜外台面上的试剂瓶，旁边标着25加仑
shots.prompt_en: Bottles of flammable liquid on an open bench beside a closed yellow safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 一个房间里柜外存放，不超过25加仑。

shots.section_title: 柜外存量有上限
shots.scene: 多出的瓶子被箭头引进安全柜
shots.prompt_en: Extra bottles with arrows guiding them into a closed yellow safety cabinet. No people.
shots.narration: 超过的部分，要放进合规的储存柜。

shots.section_title: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
shots.scene: 水滴图标与易燃液体瓶之间有一道墙
shots.prompt_en: A water drop icon with a reactive powder jar on one side of a wall and a flammable liquid bottle on the other side. No people.
shots.narration: 遇水可能引发火灾的物质，
overlay: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室

shots.section_title: 遇水危险品不与易燃液体同室
shots.scene: 两个房间图标，各放一类物质
shots.prompt_en: Two separate room icons, one holding a sealed jar with a water drop icon and the other holding a flammable liquid bottle. No people.
shots.narration: 不能和易燃液体放在同一个房间。

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书随手可查
shots.scene: 安全柜旁的文件架上放着空白说明书
shots.prompt_en: A wall rack next to a chemical cabinet holding blank safety data sheet folders with red diamond pictograms. No people.
shots.narration: 相关人员要能随时方便地查到说明书。
overlay: 安全技术说明书随手可查

shots.section_title: 安全技术说明书随手可查
shots.scene: 两名学生一起用平板查看说明书
shots.prompt_en: The young male student and the female graduate student look up a blank safety data sheet on a tablet together.
shots.narration: 里面详细写着每种物质特有的危害。

shots.section_title: 规则和培训到位，才能动手
shots.scene: 几个不同颜色的烧瓶，各带不同图标
shots.prompt_en: Several flasks of different colored liquids, each with a different hazard pictogram above it. No people.
shots.narration: 每种化学品的性质都不一样。
overlay: 规则和培训到位，才能动手

shots.section_title: 规则和培训到位，才能动手
shots.scene: 未经培训的手伸向试剂柜，被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A hand reaching for a chemical cabinet, crossed out with a red X, next to a blank training certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 规则没定好、培训没做完，

shots.section_title: 规则和培训到位，才能动手
shots.scene: 王老师拿着规程，阿杰在听讲
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank procedure binder while the young male student listens.
shots.narration: 谁都不能操作或储存这种化学品。

shots.section_title: 结合本工作场所组织培训
shots.scene: 通用证书图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A generic certificate icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 针对具体危险物品，没有通用认证课程。
overlay: 结合本工作场所组织培训

shots.section_title: 结合本工作场所组织培训
shots.scene: 王老师在本实验室现场带学生认识试剂柜
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator walks students through the chemical cabinets inside their own lab.
shots.narration: 要按自己工作场所的情况组织培训，

shots.section_title: 结合本工作场所组织培训
shots.scene: 学生们点头，头顶亮起灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The students nod with light bulb icons above their heads.
shots.narration: 达到法规要求，让每个人心中有数。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安全柜和标签图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a yellow safety cabinet and a blank label with a red diamond.
shots.narration: 易燃进柜，容器合格，内容清楚。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 火焰、太阳、通道、水滴四个打叉图标
shots.prompt_en: Four crossed-out icons: a flame, the sun, a corridor and a water drop. No people.
shots.narration: 远离火源阳光，不占通道，遇水物分开。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 说明书和培训两个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green checks: a data sheet and a training session. No people.
shots.narration: 说明书随手查，培训到位再动手。

shots.section_title: 结尾
shots.scene: 欣欣关好安全柜门，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes the door of a tidy safety cabinet and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 放得对、管得严，下次见！
